nodes.klein: to weigh, balance; to weigh out, pay money; to consider, examine. he weighed, balanced; he weighed out a price (i.e. ‘paid money’); he paid half a ‘shekel’ to the temple; he paid a ‘shekel’ to the Zionist organization; he examined, considered; it weighed. was weighed, was balanced, was weighed out; was considered, assessed, was examined. he considered; assessed, examined; he balanced. was considered, was assessed, was examined; was balanced. he weighed himself. he sold a Zionist shekel. (see שׁקלל).
